subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should Control UI close this issue with a larger fixed initial history window, or require load-older pagination using the existing chat.history offset contract?
rationale: Source proves the current cap and the backend offset capability, but docs also describe bounded recent history for stability, so the right UX/performance tradeoff needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep the initial request bounded and close this only after Control UI can fetch older history pages on demand.

options.title: Accept a larger fixed window
options.body: Let the linked fixed-cap PR proceed after real Control UI proof shows the larger request and render window are acceptable.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep the initial request bounded and close this only after Control UI can fetch older history pages on demand.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent adjacent Control UI/WebChat history and product-shape provenance for the UX/performance tradeoff.
